macros.name: addlegendentry
macros.doc: Adds a single legend entry to the legend list.

macros.name: addlegendentryexpanded
macros.doc: A variant of \addlegendentry which provides a method to deal with macros inside of ⟨TeX text⟩.

macros.name: addlegendimage
macros.doc: Adds a further legend image for legend creation.

macros.name: axisdefaultheight
macros.doc: This macro defines the default height. It is preset to 207pt.

macros.name: axisdefaultwidth
macros.doc: This macro defines the default width. It is preset to 240pt.

macros.name: closedcycle
macros.doc: Provide \closedcycle as ⟨trailing path commands⟩ after \addplot to draw a closed line from the last plot coordinate to the first one.

macros.name: coordindex
macros.doc: Yields the current index of the table row (starting with 0).

macros.name: legend
macros.doc: The argument of \legend is a list of entries, one for each plot.

macros.name: lineno
macros.doc: Yields the current line number (starting with 0).

macros.name: logten
macros.doc: Expands to the constant log(10).

macros.name: nexttick
macros.doc: This command is only valid if the x tick label as interval option is set (or the corresponding variable for y). It will contain the position of the next tick position, that means the right boundary of the tick interval.

macros.name: numplots
macros.doc: Inside of any of the axis environments, associated style, option or command, \numplots expands to the total number of plots.

macros.name: numplotsofactualtype
macros.doc: Like \numplots, this macro returns the total number of plots which have the same plot handler.

macros.name: pgfaddpath
macros.doc: Appends the softpath from the macro ⟨\softpathmacro⟩ to the current softpath.

macros.name: pgfaddpathandBB
macros.doc: Appends the softpath of macro ⟨\softpathmacro⟩ to the current softpath. This updates the picture’s bounding box by the coordinates found inside of ⟨\softpathmacro⟩.

macros.name: pgfcomputeintersectionsegments
macros.doc: Given that some intersections have been computed already (and are in the current scope), this command computes the intersection segments for one of the input arguments. On output, \pgfretval contains the number of computed segments.

macros.name: pgfcomputereversepath
macros.doc: Takes a softpath ⟨\softpathmacro⟩ and computes its reversed path. It stores the resulting softpath into \pgfretval.

macros.name: pgfgetintersectionsegmentpath
macros.doc: Defines \pgfretval to contain the desired path segment as softpath.

macros.name: pgfpathcomputesoftclippath
macros.doc: Does the work for soft clip: it computes the soft-clip path of ⟨\inputsoftpath⟩ when it is clipped against ⟨\softclippath⟩.

macros.name: pgfpathreplacefirstmoveto
macros.doc: Takes a macro containing a softpath on input, replaces its first moveto operation by a lineto operation and returns it as \pgfretval.

macros.name: pgfplotsaxistransformcs
macros.doc: Expects the current point in a set of keys, provided in the coordinate system ⟨fromname⟩ and replaces them by the same coordinates represented in ⟨toname⟩.

macros.name: pgfplotscolorbardrawstandalone
macros.doc: A command which draws a tikzpicture and a colorbar using the current colorbar settings inside of it.

macros.name: pgfplotscolormapgetcolorspace
macros.doc: The macro \pgfplotscolormapgetcolorspace{⟨name⟩} defines \pgfplotsretval to contain the color space of an existing colormap name, if you are in doubt.

macros.name: pgfplotscolormaplastindexof
macros.doc: Expands to the last index of ⟨colormap name⟩, i.e. it is a convenience method to access N − 1.

macros.name: pgfplotscolormapsizeof
macros.doc: Expands to the number of colors which make up ⟨colormap name⟩.

macros.name: pgfplotscolormaptoshadingspec
macros.doc: A command which converts a colormap into a pgf shading’s color specification.

macros.name: pgfplotsdefinecstransform
macros.doc: Defines a new coordinate system transformation.

macros.name: pgfplotsextra
macros.doc: A command to execute ⟨low-level path commands⟩ in a pgfplots axis.

macros.name: pgfplotsiffileexists
macros.doc: Invokes ⟨true code⟩ if ⟨filename⟩ exists and ⟨false code⟩ if not.

macros.name: pgfplotsinvokeforeach
macros.doc: A variant of \pgfplotsforeachungrouped (and such also of \foreach) which replaces any occurrence of #1 inside of ⟨command⟩ once for every element in ⟨list⟩.

macros.name: pgfplotspathaxisoutline
macros.doc: Generates a path which resembles the outline of the current axis.

macros.name: pgfplotspointaxisdirectionxyz
macros.doc: Point commands like \pgfpointxy which take logical, relative coordinates and return a low-level point. Every transformation from user transformations to logarithms is applied.

macros.name: pgfplotspointaxisorigin
macros.doc: A point coordinate at the origin, (0, 0, 0). If the origin is not part of the axis limits, the nearest point on the boundary is returned instead.

macros.name: pgfplotspointaxisxy
macros.doc: Point commands like \pgfpointxy which take logical, absolute coordinates and return a low-level point. Every transformation from user transformations to logarithms is applied.

macros.name: pgfplotspointaxisxyz
macros.doc: Point commands like \pgfpointxy which take logical, absolute coordinates and return a low-level point. Every transformation from user transformations to logarithms is applied.

macros.name: pgfplotspointmeta
macros.doc: The macro \pgfplotspointmeta contains whatever has been selected by the point meta key, it defaults to the y-coordinate for two dimensional plots and the z-coordinate for three dimensional plots.

macros.name: pgfplotspointmetatransformed
macros.doc: The mapped value is available as \pgfplotspointmetatransformed. This special value allows to define some property of the plot: it can be the color (together with colormap).

macros.name: pgfplotspointouternormalvectorofaxis
macros.doc: A point command which yields the outer normal vector of the respective axis.

macros.name: pgfplotspointplotattime
macros.doc: This command is part of the pos={⟨fraction⟩} implementation: it defines the current point of pgf to ⟨fraction⟩ of the current plot.

macros.name: pgfplotspointrelaxisxy
macros.doc: Point commands which take relative coordinates such that x = 0 is the lower x-axis limit and x = 1 the upper x-axis limit.

macros.name: pgfplotspointrelaxisxyz
macros.doc: Point commands which take relative coordinates such that x = 0 is the lower x-axis limit and x = 1 the upper x-axis limit.

macros.name: pgfplotspointunitx
macros.doc: The \pgfplotspointunitx is the pgf unit vector in x direction.

macros.name: pgfplotspointunitz
macros.doc: Low-level point commands which return the canvas x, y or z unit vectors.

macros.name: pgfplotsqpointdescriptionxy
macros.doc: Point commands such that {0}{0} is the lower left corner of the axis’ bounding box and {1}{1} the upper right one; everything else is in between.

macros.name: pgfplotsqpointoutsideofaxis
macros.doc: Provides a point coordinate on one of the available four axes in case of a two dimensional figure or on one of the available twelve axes in case of a three dimensional figure.

macros.name: pgfplotsqpointoutsideofaxisrel
macros.doc: This point coordinate is a variant of \pgfplotsqpointoutsideofaxis which allows to provide an ⟨axis fraction⟩ instead of an absolute coordinate. The fraction is a number between 0 (lower axis limit) and 1 (upper axis limit), i.e. it is given in percent of the total axis.

macros.name: pgfplotssetlayers
macros.doc: An alias for \pgfplotsset{set layers}. It activates the layers/default layer configuration.

macros.name: pgfplotstablecreatecol
macros.doc: Creates a new column named ⟨new col name⟩ and appends it to an already existing table ⟨\table⟩.

macros.name: pgfplotstableforeachcolumn
macros.doc: Iterates over every column name of ⟨table⟩.

macros.name: pgfplotstableforeachcolumnelement
macros.doc: Reports every table cell tij for a fixed column j in read-only mode.

macros.name: pgfplotstablegetcolumnnamebyindex
macros.doc: Retrieves the column name at ⟨col index⟩ from a ⟨table⟩ and stores it into a ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: pgfplotstablegetelem
macros.doc: Selects a single table element at row ⟨row⟩ and column ⟨col⟩.

macros.name: pgfplotstablemodifyeachcolumnelement
macros.doc: A routine which is similar to \pgfplotstableforeachcolumnelement, but any changes of ⟨\cellcontent⟩ which might occur during ⟨code⟩ will be written back into the respective cell.

macros.name: pgfplotstableread
macros.doc: Loads a table into the TeX macro ⟨\macro⟩. This macro will store the table as internal structure and can be used multiple times.

macros.name: pgfplotstabletypeset

args.placeholder: file name, macro or inline table

macros.doc: Loads (or acquires) a table and typesets it using the current configuration of number formats and table options.

macros.name: pgfplotstabletypesetfile
macros.doc: Loads the table ⟨file name⟩ and typesets it.

macros.name: pgfplotstransformcoordinatex
macros.doc: Defines \pgfmathresult to be the low-level pgf coordinate corresponding to the input argument. The command applies any [xyz] coord trafo keys, data scalings and/or logarithms or whatever pgfplots does to map input coordinates to internal coordinates.

macros.name: pgfplotstransformcoordinatey
macros.doc: Defines \pgfmathresult to be the low-level pgf coordinate corresponding to the input argument. The command applies any [xyz] coord trafo keys, data scalings and/or logarithms or whatever pgfplots does to map input coordinates to internal coordinates.

macros.name: pgfplotstransformcoordinatez
macros.doc: Defines \pgfmathresult to be the low-level pgf coordinate corresponding to the input argument. The command applies any [xyz] coord trafo keys, data scalings and/or logarithms or whatever pgfplots does to map input coordinates to internal coordinates.

macros.name: pgfplotstransformdirectionx
macros.doc: Defines \pgfmathresult to be a low-level pgf direction vector component.

macros.name: pgfplotstransformdirectiony
macros.doc: Defines \pgfmathresult to be a low-level pgf direction vector component.

macros.name: pgfplotstransformdirectionz
macros.doc: Defines \pgfmathresult to be a low-level pgf direction vector component.

macros.name: pgfplotsunitxinvlength
macros.doc: Macros which expand to the vector length ∥xi ∥ of the respective unit vector xi or the inverse vector length, 1/∥xi ∥.

macros.name: pgfplotsutilifstringequal
macros.doc: A simple “strcmp” tool which invokes ⟨true code⟩ if ⟨first⟩ =⟨second⟩ and ⟨false code⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: pgfplotsvalueoflargesttickdimen
macros.doc: Expands to the largest distance of a tick position to its tick label bounding box in direction of the outer unit normal vector. It does also include the value of the ticklabel shift key.

macros.name: pgfsetpathandBB
macros.doc: Replaces the current softpath from the macro ⟨\softpathmacro⟩. This updates the picture’s bounding box by the coordinates found inside of ⟨\softpathmacro⟩.

macros.name: plotnum
macros.doc: Inside of \addplot or any associated style, option or command, \plotnum expands to the current plot’s number, starting with 0.

macros.name: plotnumofactualtype
macros.doc: Like \plotnum, but it returns the number among all plots of the same type.

macros.name: thisrow
macros.doc: Yields the value of the column designated by ⟨column name⟩.

macros.name: thisrowno
macros.doc: Similar to \thisrow, this command yields the value of the column with index ⟨column index⟩ (starting with 0).

macros.name: tick
macros.doc: The current element of option xtick (or ytick).

macros.name: ticknum
macros.doc: The current tick number, starting with 0 (it is a macro containing a number).

macros.name: tikzfillbetween
macros.doc: This is the low-level interface of fill between; it generates one or more paths.

macros.name: tikzgetnamedpath
macros.doc: Defines \pgfretval to contain the softpath associated with ⟨string name⟩.

macros.name: tikznamecurrentpath
macros.doc: Takes the current softpath (the one assembled by previous moveto, lineto, or whatever operations), and assigns the name ⟨string name⟩ to it.

macros.name: tikzpathintersectionsegments
macros.doc: An alias for \tikzset{intersection segments={⟨options⟩}}.

macros.name: tikzsegmentindex
macros.doc: A command which is valid while the paths of \addplot fill between are generated. It expands to the segment ⟨index⟩, i.e. the same value which is used by every segment no ⟨index⟩.

envs.name: pgfplotsinterruptdatabb
envs.doc: Everything in ⟨environment contents⟩ will not contribute to the data bounding box.

envs.name: ternaryaxis
envs.doc: The axis environment for ternary axes.
